room_rent.note: Policy wording covers room rent as part of in-patient treatment but no explicit room rent cap or category is stated in the schedule of benefits

icu.note: ICU covered under in-patient treatment but no explicit cap mentioned

copayment.note: No co-payment clause found in the policy wording

sub_limits.note: Maternity: Normal ₹15k, C-section ₹25k; Ambulance: ₹2,000/hosp; Daily cash shared room: ₹500/day max ₹3,000; Daily cash child: ₹300/day max ₹9,000; Dental OPD: ₹1,000/yr; No sub-limits on main in-patient treatment

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months continuous coverage; no optional reduction mentioned

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) excluded for 24 months

maternity.note: Normal delivery ₹15,000; C-section ₹25,000 (incl. pre/post natal ₹1,500 & infant ₹2,000); limited to 2 deliveries lifetime; does not reduce main SI

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added each renewal irrespective of claims; max 50% of base SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

pre_hosp.note: Standard 30 days; extended to 60 days if medical documents and hospitalisation details provided at least 5 days in advance

post_hosp.note: Standard 60 days; extended to 90 days if hospitalisation pre-notified with documents at least 5 days in advance

day_care.note: Day care procedures under general or local anaesthesia covered

domiciliary.note: Covered when hospitalisation not possible on doctor's advice; condition must continue at least 3 days

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered in recognised AYUSH hospitals; OPD AYUSH not covered

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered; donor's pre/post-hosp expenses excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: No explicit mention of modern/robotic surgery coverage or sub-limits in the policy wording

consumables.note: Consumables listed as non-medical expenses and excluded; gloves, nebulisation kits, etc. in exclusion list

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Stem cell harvesting, congenital external anomalies, sleep apnoea investigation, spinal manipulation, hearing aids, cochlear implants (non-accident), alopecia treatment, OPD treatment

optional_riders.display: Critical Illness lump sum (₹3L), Newborn baby cover
